text.formatted:
A creature requires an amount of water per day based on its size, as shown in the table. A creature that drinks less than half the required water for a day gains 1 Exhaustion level at the day's end. Exhaustion caused by dehydration can't be removed until the creature drinks the full amount of water required for a day. _See also_ "Exhaustion."

| Size       | Water      |
|------------|------------|
| Tiny       | 1/4 gallon |
| Small      | 1 gallon   |
| Medium     | 1 gallon   |
| Large      | 4 gallons  |
| Huge       | 16 gallons |
| Gargantuan | 64 gallons |
